Our experienced team of dental professionals is committed to providing exceptional care with the highest standards of clinical excellence and patient comfort.

Welcome to our Charlotte University office! Right off Interstate 85, and near the UNC Charlotte Botanical Gardens, our Charlotte University location provides care for patients traveling from the nearby neighborhoods such as University City, Huntersville, Concord, and more. With our highly advanced technology and an experienced team, we provide the comfort and confidence you need for a healthy, pain-free smile!

Our modern, inviting space is filled with a professional, experienced team that strongly believes that dental care and treatment start with patient comfort. Therefore, we strive for our office and amenities to be designed with our patients’ health and well-being in mind. Situated in a suburban community that blends small-town charm with convenient access to the Northlake Mall, this location is accessible and easy to travel to. Our Charlotte University office stands out with its peaceful atmosphere, where patients feel supported and leave motivated to take care of their oral health with ease and comfort.
We believe in the Riccobene Way - a commitment to deliver better dentistry, better experiences and better results with a comprehensive and compassionate approach.

We won’t leave you in pain and will do what it takes to care for you!

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
Do University Area Charlotte dentists provide cosmetic dentistry services?

Yes, we understand the impact a confident smile has on our patients' lives, and therefore, we offer cosmetic services that include whitening, veneers, and Invisalign®.

Are there nearby dental offices in the University Area that accept walk-ins or emergency cases?

Yes. At our office, we recognize that emergencies happen and offer care in times of need. We will do our very best to get you in as soon as possible, ideally the same or next day if you contact us outside of operating hours. If we can’t see you at our location, we will redirect you to our other nearby offices that may be able to accommodate short notice, after-hours, or weekend visits for emergencies. We won’t leave you in pain and will do what it takes to care for you!

What advanced services, like implants or root canals, are offered at University Area dental offices?

Our team of experts is here to help you with all your dental issues, including implants and root canals. You can schedule an appointment or request a consultation to make sure you’re getting the best treatment suited available.
